scripts.workspace:status: echo Product Foundation Starter workspace is ready
scripts.build:foundation: pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc build && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client build && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-server build && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-core build && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-postgres build
scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-client test && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/rpc-server test && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-core test && pnpm --filter @product-foundation/backend-postgres test && pnpm --filter @app/api test
